positive.prompt: Make this endpoint faster and prove the change beats the benchmark distribution's noise.
Establish repeatable timing baselines, optimize the hot path, and compare spread as well as median.
Use the project's benchmark harness to decide whether this speedup is measurable.

negative.prompt: Remove duplicated forwarding modules without changing behavior or any test file.
This CI crash has a concrete stack trace; reproduce and repair that known failure.

evals.prompt: Optimize a measured hot path while preserving all observable results. Describe the correctness gate around the builder.
evals.expected_output: A benchmarked optimization transcript using a green baseline seal and no specifier.
expectations: No specifier is dispatched for the behavior-preserving optimization.
An integrator proves the existing correctness tests green and seals them before the refactor-mode builder.
The tests remain byte-identical and the post-change benchmark is compared against baseline spread.
